result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the metadata line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has overlapping text that makes the delivery time unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the subtitle text collides: 'min' overlaps the start of 'delivery', rendering as garbled '25-30delivery · Ramen' instead of a readable delivery-time line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so the time, unit, and label don't overlap — render it as '25–30 min delivery · Ramen' with proper spacing, or allow the line to wrap if space is insufficient.
